Name: Dontstoptime
Author: fairnot
Description:
So now that we have the best mod (Timespeed) that allows us to slow time in singleplayer, i've found that as i use a lot the menu, and go fishing, and etc, that dead time makes the days ultra longer, therefore i've found that a multiplayer pace time is better for me, therefore i went to ChatGpt and voila, here this small mod, that i've tested it a bit.

Functionality:

- Time never stops in any message prompt (pause, eating, etc)
- Npcs and Enemies don't freeze while pausing (Enemies hit you while you in the inventory as the same as multiplayer)
- Compatibility with GenericModConfigMenu
- Functionality as in multiplayer, /pause pauses the game and enemies as it disables the mod, /resume or /pause again enables the mod and unpauses it

Manifest.Description: Time never pauses as in multiplayer
